spec.name: t6: max under order tu<gu<vi<za<ze via sort-rank circuit
spec.code:
def predict(tokens, prompt):
    # tokens = [BOS, x1..x5]; ids: gu=2, tu=3, vi=4, za=5, ze=6
    # Order tu < gu < vi < za < ze (E0001, E0003: gu beats tu; otherwise id order).
    order = {3: 0, 2: 1, 4: 2, 5: 3, 6: 4}
    xs = list(tokens[1:6])
    # mlp0/mlp1: per-position ranking key (E0016). Head 2.1 + mlp2: stable ascending sort rank
    # r_i = #(j: x_j lower, or equal and earlier) (E0010, E0011).
    ranks = [sum(1 for j in range(5) if order[xs[j]] < order[xs[i]] or (xs[j] == xs[i] and j < i)) for i in range(5)]
    # Head 3.1 at the last position attends to the position with rank 4 and copies its symbol (E0012, E0014).
    return xs[ranks.index(4)]
